meta.purpose: 追踪 source_board_run_id 全依赖链，提出 Slice 2 目标：Review identity 不再依赖 BoardAnalysisRun，替代身份方案先列约束不迁 schema。

dependency_chain: MarketReviewRun (create_run unique constraint: trade_date + source_core_run_id + source_board_run_id + algo + filter)
scope discovery (_list_board_scopes_by_hierarchy uses source_board_run_id to enumerate board scopes)
Review persistence / API / publication (product_readiness_service PC-41 lineage check)

1_lineage_only.description: 仅用 source_board_run_id 做 lineage 身份/存在性校验，不读 Board analytics
locations: review_orchestrator_service.py:892 _list_board_scopes_by_hierarchy (用 id 枚举 board scope)

2_reads_board_payload.description: 真正读取 BoardAnalysisSnapshot/pyramid_v2 analytics payload
2_reads_board_payload.note: 这是唯一真正消费 Board ANALYTICS 的 Review 路径（member attribution）。Slice 2 需决定 attribution 是否改用 Review canonical facts。

3_unique_constraints.description: 包含 source_board_run_id 的唯一约束 / idempotency key
locations: MarketReviewRun unique: (trade_date, source_core_run_id, source_board_run_id, algo, filter)
Review resume_run idempotency 依赖 source_board_run_id
product_readiness_service.py:683 lineage exposes source_board_run_id in readiness payload
product_readiness_service.py:1228-1237 (run_board.source_board_run_id == current market_aggregation pointer.data_run_id else degraded/blocked)
review_orchestrator_service.py:574 PC-40 (pointer 必须存在否则 fail-fast)

slice2_target_proposal.goal: Review identity should no longer depend on BoardAnalysisRun
constraints: C1: 必须保留 lineage 可追溯 (Review run 能回溯到 PIT membership + taxonomy 版本)
C2: idempotency key 必须仍能区分同 trade_date 不同 membership/taxonomy 的 run
C3: PC-40/PC-41 校验需替换为等价约束 (Review 只消费 formal pointer，pointer 身份改为 taxonomy+membership identity)
C4: ScopeDefinition 仍需 taxonomy_version + taxonomy_compatibility_key + membership_version (不能因删 Board runtime 删 lineage)
C5: attribution (review_attribution_service) 需改用 Review canonical facts 替代 Board snapshot payload
slice2_target_proposal.schema_change: DEFER to Slice 2 — 本轮只定义 target + constraints，不迁 schema
